description: Generate fictional US-format phone numbers. Use for US demo phone fields; when supplied, city selects a local area-code pool and must match state. Returns an array of fictional (AAA) 555-01XX numbers; no subscriber lookup.

city.description: Optional city: Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Houston or Miami; must match state if given.

count.description: Number of fabricated numbers, up to eight.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed for repeatable test numbers.

state.description: Optional US state abbreviation: CA, NY, TX or FL.

name: generate-phone-number
title: Generate fictional US phone fixtures
